page_title: REN 3-1 NAN | Rennes v Nantes 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' 3 - 1 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Alban Lafont.
90+6' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+6' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Rennes after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
90+1' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Guela Doue (Rennes) replaces Ludovic Blas.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Bertug Yildirim will be replaced by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
87' Ruddy Buquet shows a yellow card to Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
85' Pierre Aristouy prepares a substitution. Douglas Augusto is replaced by Moussa Sissoko (Nantes).
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) is replacing Jean-Kevin Duverne.
81' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
81' The game has come to an end for Benjamin Bourigeaud. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
80' Amine Gouiri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
79' The free kick from long range, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
77' Was it necessary? Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Ruddy Buquet had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
77' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
76' Here is a change. Samuel Moutoussamy is going off and Pierre Aristouy gives the last tactical orders to Adson (Nantes).
74' Ruddy Buquet sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
73' The Rennes players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

73' 2 - 1 Goal! Adrien Truffert displays great vision and sends a pass to Desire Doue (Rennes), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
70' That will be all from Fabian Rieder who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Desire Doue (Rennes).
69' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
62' Ruddy Buquet shows the yellow card to Nemanja Matic (Rennes) for a heavy challenge.
61' Here comes a substitution. Kader Bamba (Nantes) is brought on as a substitute for Florent Mollet.
61' A yellow card for a tackle by Pedro Chirivella (Nantes). Ruddy Buquet doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' Ruddy Buquet shows a yellow card to Douglas Augusto (Nantes) for a tough tackle.
58' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ruddy Buquet ignores the protests.
58' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) sees a yellow card from Ruddy Buquet after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
57' Rennes are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
55' The foul by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ruddy Buquet.
54' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
53' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
49' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
47' The free kick from long range, taken by Nantes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 1 - 1 Goal! Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the middle of the net. Steve Mandanda is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
44' Florent Mollet (Nantes) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Steve Mandanda gets down to his right to keep it out.
44' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
43' The free kick from long range, taken by Nantes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Nantes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' Moses Simon (Nantes) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by Steve Mandanda.
37' Today's referee Ruddy Buquet rightly decides to book Florent Mollet (Nantes) for his harsh tackle.
35' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
33' The ball is behind the sideline. Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) takes a throw-in.
29' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Florent Mollet (Nantes) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda is equal to it and makes an easy save.
27' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
22' Florent Mollet (Nantes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Steve Mandanda intercepts the ball.
21' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is behind the touchline and Rennes will take a throw-in.
18' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
16' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.

14' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the right side of the target as Alban Lafont produces a good save.
14' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
13' Florent Mollet (Nantes) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Steve Mandanda.
12' Great teamplay by Nantes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) takes a short corner kick.
8' Good team movement sets up Florent Mollet (Nantes) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alban Lafont into middle of the goal.
6' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
5' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for an infringement.
5' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) jumps into a tackle and Ruddy Buquet signals a foul. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Rennes!
3' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Rennes will take the kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
